verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sat roop sat naam satigur giaan dhiaan satigur mat sun sat kar maanee hai ||

en.bdb: The granter of knowledge and contemplation of ever stable form and name (Lord) is True Guru. A Guru-conscious person listens to the teachings of the True Guru and practices His words in his deeds and actions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharas dhiaan samadharasee braham dhiaanee sabadh giaan gur braham giaanee hai ||

en.bdb: By virtue of glimpse and contemplation of the True Guru, a Guru-oriented person treats all uniformly. And as such he is Lord-conscious person and because of the knowledge of the words of Guru, he is Lord aware person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmat nihachal pooran pragaas ridhai maanai man maane unaman unamaanee hai ||

en.bdb: By practicing the teachings of the True Guru completely and with patience, the light effulgent appears within him. He is filled with the love of the Lord and he acquires higher state of spiritual being.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਸਚਰਜੈ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਠਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥੧੩੮॥
verses.translit_en: bisamai bisam asacharajai asacharaj mai adhabhut paramadhabhut gat Thaanee hai ||138||

en.bdb: By the grace of the meditation of Naam of the Lord carried out by the blessings of the True Guru, he stays in most ecstatic, strange and blissful state all the time. (138)
